answer_1.quote: we propose SEG2ACT, a global context-aware action generation approach for document logical structuring... we revisit structure extraction as an action generation task.
answer_1.outputs: sequence of actions (e.g., New Level-k Heading, New Paragraph, Concatenation) to construct a hierarchical logical tree of a document

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we use the same criteria in previous work, including F1-score and TEDS. Additionally, we add a new criterion, DocAcc, to evaluate the accuracy of logical structures at the document level.
